resources.title: Sample Customer Import File
resources.description: A ten-row customer import file with the columns a Flat File Source would read in Chapter 3 — CustomerID, FirstName, LastName, EmailAddress, City, Comments — with one row's Comments field deliberately over 50 characters. Load it with the Flat File connection manager's default settings first to reproduce Lesson 17's truncation gotcha yourself, then fix it the way Worked Example 3 does.

resources.title: SSIS Package Design & Production-Readiness Checklist
resources.description: A single reference checklist, compiled from this course's own control-flow, data-flow, error-handling, incremental-load, and deployment lessons, for reviewing a package before you call it done — the same checks Worked Examples 1 and 3 were built against.

resources.title: Data Flow Transformation Quick Reference
resources.description: A one-page cheat sheet comparing the Lookup transformation's three cache modes, the Conditional Split's order-matters evaluation rule, the Derived Column's common expression patterns, and the Slowly Changing Dimension Wizard's three attribute types — side by side, for whichever transformation you're configuring.

resources.title: Incremental Load Watermark Pattern (SQL Template)
resources.description: A reusable SQL template for the watermark pattern from Lessons 36 and 48 — the control table, its seed insert, the read-watermark query, and the update-watermark statement — with placeholders you swap for your own table and column names on any new incremental load.
